parsed.note_claim: Troy Lake was sentenced to 12 months and 1 day for disabling emissions systems on hundreds of commercial trucks at his repair business, not for fixing his own vehicle.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Lake pleaded guilty and was sentenced to serve 12 months and one day of federal prison time... an Environmental Protection Agency investigation concluded Lake had been tampering with on-board diagnostic systems since at least 2017 and in at least 344 trucks.
parsed.reason: The page directly states Lake's sentence was 12 months and one day and that he tampered with emissions systems in 344 commercial trucks at his business, substantiating the note's correction of the post's claims.
